disclaimer: Starter comparison baseline with a small number of entries. It is not a statute, not a court ruling, and not a statement that any clause is legal or illegal. Jurisdiction-specific enforceability should be reviewed by a qualified legal professional.

entries.title: Payment terms
entries.standard_expectation: Invoices should be payable within a stated number of days.
entries.comparison_guidance: Flag payment timing left to one party's discretion.
entries.financial_basis: Unknown unless a fee and period are stated.
entries.suggested_revision: The client shall pay each undisputed invoice within 30 days of receipt.
entries.why_it_matters: Open-ended payment timing makes cash flow unpredictable.
entries.source_notes: ClauseLens starter comparison baseline. Not a legal requirement.

entries.title: Limitation of liability
entries.standard_expectation: Each party's liability should be capped, commonly by reference to fees paid.
entries.comparison_guidance: Flag uncapped liability for one party.
entries.financial_basis: Uncapped liability has no defensible maximum. Exposure is unknown.
entries.suggested_revision: Each party's total liability under this agreement shall not exceed the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim.
entries.why_it_matters: Without a cap, the potential amount cannot be calculated from the agreement.
entries.source_notes: ClauseLens starter comparison baseline. Not a legal requirement.

entries.title: Termination
entries.standard_expectation: Either party should be able to end the agreement on stated written notice, with fees paid for work done.
entries.comparison_guidance: Flag termination that forfeits fees for work already done.
entries.financial_basis: Use a stated fee or formula only.
entries.suggested_revision: Either party may terminate on 30 days' written notice, and the client shall pay for services delivered up to termination.
entries.negotiation_goal: Keep payment for delivered work on termination.
entries.why_it_matters: Forfeiting earned fees is a direct financial exposure.
entries.source_notes: ClauseLens starter comparison baseline. Not a legal requirement.
